items.question: What is New Dawn?
items.answer: A space for those who want to grow. Inside — Jiva (your AI Friend and guide), a community of fellow travelers, and simple pillars: diary, image of the day, a feed of small steps. Come as you are.

items.question: What do I get for free?
items.answer: Community and private chats — no limits. Mood diary, the "Little Sunrises" feed, the "Paths" section. 7 messages a day with Jiva. As a welcome gift — 15 conversations with Jiva Deep. No card, no deadlines.

items.question: Why Premium?
items.answer: Premium opens Jiva Deep as a daily guide: 30 conversations, long memory of your path, "Image of the day" — 3 drawings a day. $5 a month.

items.question: Can I cancel?
items.answer: Yes, anytime — one button in settings. Access stays until the end of the paid period. Jiva doesn't disappear — she simply returns to her usual mode. Come back to Premium and the memory of your path is with you again.

items.text: I open Jiva in the morning — and I see where I want to step today.
items.author: Anna, 28

items.text: After a month of the diary I finally saw what was actually changing in me.
items.author: Michael, 34

items.text: Walks beside me in a way that makes me want to come back and take the next step.
items.author: Elena, 42

creatorLetter.title: Letter from the Creator
creatorLetter.intro: This is the creator of New Dawn.
creatorLetter.body:
For the past week you've used the platform in full: Jiva, "Image of the day", every tool of the path. I hope it brought a little more clarity.

I build this project with my own money, and AI is expensive (servers, models). I can't pay for it for everyone forever.

So now you have a choice:

premium.title: Support the project
premium.description: Full access to Jiva and every tool of the path
features: "Image of the day" with Jiva's warm reflection

free.title: Stay free
free.description: Basic tools of the path stay open

creatorLetter.thanks: The choice is yours. Either way — thank you for being here, on the path.
